note: Recovered register for Spec 063 (successor to Spec 056, sign 821 identification) at the freeze act of 2026-10-21, under the owner's approval of the same date (amendment package Item 5), on the authoritative draft at Amendment Queue Item 5 sections 6.1, 7 and 8. The draft register (0.5-draft) already carried engine evidence values (kind observed, source_quality artifact) and mutual independent_of declarations, so no loadability recovery was needed: round 1 of the AEE lifecycle hooks loaded it as drafted and returned 16 failure modes - 15 FR-2.3 draft-cap records and 1 irreducibility challenge recorded under the engine's coverage_gap category (F063-C12) - with minimum propagated score 0.795 and no claim below the 0.70 threshold. ASM- ids name the assumptions each claim stands on: ASM-HELD-SOURCE (the held cleaned text is the source of record for Wells 2015; its hash governs over any other copy), ASM-056-RECORD (Spec 056's executed record is the evidence of record for candidate K-1 and its R-1, R-2, R-4 and R-5 passes, on the pinned passage), ASM-PRESERVED-REFERENCE (the drawn-form reference preserved in this spec's directory at its freeze-pinned digest is the reference the section 5 protocol checks, and is itself checked at step D), ASM-CLAIM-FORM (a claim in this program's form states a proposition about an identified subject with a statable falsification condition), ASM-TWO-DERIVATION (two independent descriptor derivations plus feature-settled reconciliation are a trustworthy instrument for the drawn-form judgement), ASM-GATES-BEFORE-OUTCOME (integrity and pinning precede any identification step), ASM-APPEND-ONLY (outcomes append; prior and frozen records are never edited), ASM-OPEN-DEPOSIT (the Wells 2006 thesis is an open deposit and a text descriptor derived from its plates is a lawful derived factual record, per the amendment draft section 4).

claims.text: An outcome under Spec 063 states nothing about sign 821 itself.
claims.boundary: The scope is one candidate (K-1, of record in Spec 056's execution) and one identification question: whether the drawn sign Wells's 821 labels can be identified under spec section 5's protocol. It excludes any statement that sign 821 means 'city' or anything else, any statement about the sign's reading, classification, or distribution beyond the identification itself, and any statement about any other sign or claim. Carried from Spec 056's fence (F056-C01): an outcome states only whether candidate K-1 is recovered in the program's claim form on the new record, or the run closes.
alternatives: the identification act could be read as a finding about the sign's meaning (it cannot: identification fixes which drawn sign the number labels, not what the sign means)
falsification_tests: the claim is falsified in scope if any Spec 063 output states a conclusion about what sign 821 means, about another sign, or about another claim

metadata.strongest_rival: the alternative reading in which identifying the sign settles its suggested meaning
metadata.verdict_rule: scope is judged by inspection of every Spec 063 output against this boundary; any output exceeding it is a defect of the output, recorded as such, not a finding

claims.text: The descriptor derivation is performed twice independently.
claims.boundary: Spec section 5 step D: two independent derivations of the drawn-form descriptor from the thesis plate, each performed without sight of the other and without sight of the preserved record's drafted descriptor wording, each recording the plate locator, the feature list it read (stroke count, outline, internal divisions), and the neighbour set it discriminated against.
